title: Daily Brief — Afternoon Edition — Monday, 19 October 2026
description: AI chip startups challenging Nvidia secure fresh funding from Arm, Qatar and SoftBank, Australia becomes the first country outside the US to operate the AIM-260 missile, Queensland's new Governor Thomas Bradley is appointed, and the Gold Coast hands down its $2.7B budget with a trimmed rate rise. 한국어로도 브리핑을 전해드립니다.
